svg.text: Figure 4: The Qwen 3.5 9B architecture, in the style of Vaswani et al. (2017): decoder-only and pre-norm; three of every four layers mix tokens with a Gated DeltaNet, a linear-attention layer whose state is a fixed 128 × 128 matrix per head,
and the fourth with gated full attention.
